subject: Physics
question: A body of mass $5\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a smooth horizontal surface by a force of $20\text{ N}$ inclined at $60^\circ$ to the horizontal. Calculate the acceleration of the body.
explanation:
Step 1: Resolve the pulling force along the horizontal:
   $F_x = F \cos 60^\circ = 20 \times 0.5 = 10\text{ N}$.
Step 2: Apply Newton's second law: $F_x = ma \implies a = \frac{F_x}{m}$.
Step 3: $a = \frac{10}{5} = 2.0\text{ m/s}^2$.
Result: $2.0\text{ m/s}^2$.
